Name: Mathematic Orchards - Fruit Tree Price Change
Author: Imbion
Description:
I was doing some calculations, and I realized that the fruit produce of trees doesn't even pay for itself on its first year. Artisan goods are supposed to help with this, but - no, I disagree. I highly disagree with this being the case. That's lame. It makes greenhouse saplings the dominant strategy without even slight consideration for using the trees outside of the first year. Here, I made a content patcher mod that fixes this.

[u][b]Requirements:
[/b][/u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13228]Content Patcher[/url]﻿

[u][b]What it does:
[/b][/u]Through the power of math, this mod changes the price of fruit produce so their seasonal output is more than their sapling price. More expensive trees make more money per season. Compatible with everything except for things that change the price of fruit.

Spreadsheet of all of the changes are [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1uEO1bOQfCx1RbZYXAtCRJ_-l6WdlDDXG7d4B4BfMJWo/edit?usp=sharing]here[/url].

Downloads.Description: Cornucopia and Ridgeside compatibility, config file, tree fruit recipe price options.

Manifest.Description: Tweaks the price of fruit tree produce so the base fruit is profitable within a season.
